subject: Request: short pilot top-up while invoice & security review complete
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@novacare.com>
Cc: procurement@novacare.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — short top-up while PO & security finish review

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the update on the procurement timeline. I understand procurement and your security team still need a couple of signatures and a final review of the integration checklist. We don’t want your pilot to lose momentum.

Proposal: we can provision a short, non-billable top-up (3 days / 100k token allowance) tied to the current SOW draft while the PO gets processed. This would keep your data scientists running experiments and keep the eval signals fresh for your stakeholders.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll route it through an approval with our finance team and ask legal for a 14-day limited access addendum. Can you confirm:
- That the top-up can be used across the current pilot project only
- Whether procurement needs any additional invoice metadata (billing contact, billing address, PO number placeholder)

I can also do a 20-min sync with procurement + security if that would help unblock.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Procurement just got the final PO template back from finance but they need our legal-approved SOW and the security questionnaire responses before they’ll issue a PO. Security flagged two checklist items around data retention and key management that our InfoSec leads want clarified.

A short top-up would be super helpful — the data science team is in the middle of a model comparison and losing access would set us back a week. Two asks from our side:
1) Can the top-up be limited to the current project (so it isn’t used outside the pilot)?
2) If you provide any temporary credits, can you include invoice metadata: billing contact (accounts.payable@novacare.com) and our tentative PO number: NOV-PLT-2711 (this is a placeholder until legal issues the official PO)?

If you can accommodate that, I’ll push procurement & InfoSec to prioritize the remaining checklist items. Happy to join a call if that’d speed things along.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Cole
Director, Data Science | NovaCare Health

Attachment: NovaCare_SOW_Draft.pdf (latest SOW draft)

I’m looping in Priyom (sales ops) to request an internal approval for a 3-day, 100k-token top-up and to confirm the short addendum language for legal. Priyom — can we fast-track this as a one-off credit? If useful I can get a signed email from Samantha confirming the scope restriction.

Marcus
